title: MetaStrategy: Generative Ranking with Executable LLM Strategies
title_zh: MetaStrategy：使用可执行 LLM 策略的生成式排序
abstract_en: Industrial recommender systems rank heterogeneous content under coupled user, business, commercial, and experience objectives. Existing generative ranking methods typically construct item sequences directly, making them difficult to integrate with mature predictive models, operational rules, and field-level guardrails. We present MetaStrategy, a framework that instead generates a structured, executable ranking strategy. Conditioned on request context, a large language model (LLM) policy emits a typed JSON bundle controlling objective weights, content and category preferences, experience constraints, and position policies. A deterministic validator and compiler instantiate an isolated Generator that competes atomically with incumbents under the list-level Evaluator of the Generator-Evaluator (GE) architecture. We train the policy in a production-path replay environment that re-executes logged requests through the current re-ranking stack without user exposure. The method combines selection, relative-rank, and baseline-lift rewards, a self-competitive curriculum that feeds frequent strategies back as competitors, and Evaluator-routed reward-augmented on-policy distillation that transfers complementary 4B-parameter Teachers into a compact 0.8B-parameter Student. We deploy MetaStrategy in Taobao Homepage Guess You Like through diff-triggered nearline generation; LLM inference remains outside synchronous ranking, with no observable increase in response time (RT). In a seven-day user-randomized online A/B test, MetaStrategy wins 27.93% of treatment-side GE calls and significantly improves click page views (click PV) by 2.11%, item-detail page views (IPV) by 3.12%, and transaction amount by 2.83%.
abstract_zh: 工业推荐系统需要在用户体验、业务目标、商业收益等多种耦合目标下对异构内容进行排序。现有生成式排序方法通常直接生成 item 序列，因而难以与成熟的预测模型、运营规则和字段级约束集成。本文提出 MetaStrategy：不直接生成排序结果，而是由 LLM policy 根据请求上下文生成结构化、可执行的排序策略，即 typed JSON bundle，用于控制目标权重、内容与类目偏好、体验约束和位置策略。随后，确定性的 validator 与 compiler 将该策略实例化为隔离的 Generator，并在 Generator-Evaluator（GE）架构中通过 list-level Evaluator 与已有策略进行原子竞争。训练方面，MetaStrategy 使用 production-path replay environment，在不暴露给用户的情况下，对日志请求通过当前重排链路重新执行；奖励设计结合 selection、relative-rank 和 baseline-lift，并引入 self-competitive curriculum，将高频策略反馈为竞争对手；同时通过 Evaluator-routed reward-augmented on-policy distillation，将多个互补的 4B Teacher 迁移到紧凑的 0.8B Student。MetaStrategy 已部署于 Taobao Homepage Guess You Like，采用 diff-triggered nearline generation，使 LLM 推理位于同步排序链路之外，因此响应时间（RT）无可观测增加。七天用户随机在线 A/B 测试显示，MetaStrategy 在 treatment-side GE 调用中胜出 27.93%，并显著提升 click PV 2.11%、IPV 3.12%、成交金额 2.83%。
key_points_zh: 核心思想是从“直接生成 item 序列”转向“生成可执行排序策略”：LLM 输出 typed JSON，显式控制目标权重、内容偏好、体验约束和位置策略，更易接入现有预测模型与运营规则。
系统采用 Generator-Evaluator（GE）架构：LLM 生成的策略经 validator 和 compiler 转为隔离 Generator，再由 list-level Evaluator 与线上 incumbent 原子竞争，降低上线风险。
训练使用 production-path replay environment，在不影响真实用户的情况下复现日志请求并经过当前重排栈；奖励结合 selection、relative-rank 和 baseline-lift，以贴近线上排序收益。
提出 self-competitive curriculum 与 Evaluator-routed reward-augmented on-policy distillation，将多个 4B Teacher 的互补能力蒸馏到 0.8B Student，兼顾效果与部署成本。
在 Taobao Homepage Guess You Like 线上 A/B 测试中，MetaStrategy 使 click PV 提升 2.11%、IPV 提升 3.12%、成交金额提升 2.83%，且 LLM 推理不进入同步链路，RT 无可观测增加。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong e-commerce ranking contribution that uses executable LLM-generated strategies to improve Taobao homepage recommendation outcomes.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项很强的电商排序工作，通过可执行的 LLM 生成策略提升淘宝首页推荐效果。
